lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>attack<c> carried out by moving close to the target.
Also called a close-range attack.

It is mostly done with <c:ffff00>actions<c> of the <c:ffff00>Striking skill<c>.
Both the attacker and the one who <c:ffff00>responds<c> are
affected by the <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> stat of the <c:ffff00>legs<c>.

Depending on <c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c>, a <c:ffff00>{{graze}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c>
may occur.
